purpose: ONE bound-aware fit of the SAME classical 4PL marginal ML (no priors/MAP/Bayes) on Design B; resolves PR #149 step-0 stagnation. Committed before execution.

reuse.start: validation/four_pl_rescue/verdict_B.json parameters (R mirt BL_GH161; score 2.757, logLik -179462.838063)
reuse.prechecks: PR #149 result.json: mapping |R - common logLik| = 0; analytic vs central-difference gradient max rel 3.5e-6

inspection: PR #149 Newton: information_audit.information returns -dScore = -Hessian (PD at a maximum); d = info^-1 g is an ASCENT direction for logLik; stagnation came from rejecting every infeasible trial point (I23 c = 1.7e-4, I26 d = .99992) with no projection or active set.

algorithm.name: Bertsekas (1982) projected Newton for maximization (algorithm.py)
algorithm.active_set: x_i - lo_i <= eps & g_i < 0, or hi_i - x_i <= eps & g_i > 0; eps = min(1e-3, ||x - P(x + g)||)
algorithm.direction: free: solve(info_FF, g_F); active: g_i / info_ii
algorithm.line_search: projected arc x(t) = P(x + t d), t = 0.5^k, k = 0..20; accept first t with f(x(t)) - f(x) >= 1e-4 [t g_F.d_F + g_A.(x(t) - x)_A] (implies nondecreasing logLik, feasibility by construction)
algorithm.information: information_audit.information on GH161, step cbrt(eps), symmetrized; stop if free-face min eig <= 0 or condition > 1e8
algorithm.stopping: STATIONARY projected score <= 1e-5 | STAGNATION (no t accepted) | INFORMATION GATE | BUDGET 900 s | MAX STEPS 30
algorithm.single_run: one start, no restarts, no setting changes
algorithm.pre_fit_tests: test_algorithm.py: bounded concave quadratic reaches the known KKT point with nondecreasing f; ascent sign under the -Hessian convention

objective: common logLik on GH161 (equivalence_audit.evaluate, q1_q3.profile.gh); bounds a [.1,5], b [-6,6], c [0,.5], d [.5,1]
boundaries: recorded separately with KKT multiplier signs; regular NUMERICAL PASS still requires zero boundary estimates (PR #148 definition); a stationary boundary solution is reported as BOUNDARY SOLUTION, not PASS
recovery: only after regular NUMERICAL PASS: PR #148 criteria (RMSE a .15, b .10, c .03, d .03; max |z| <= 4)
not_done: Monte Carlo, SE/CI certification, production switch
